before: A fold listed a removed cell's lent widths after the cell's own records, so a reopen drew them over a width made later. A struck note of several paragraphs kept one empty paragraph for each struck mark after its accept. A checkpoint left out a record made over a pending one that its manifest could not list, and read a taken record the manifest did not list, or replacedEarlier with no replaced.
after: A fold lists the lent widths with the cell's records in the order they were made. A struck note keeps only its last paragraph, as the engine keeps a story's last one. A checkpoint refuses (engine-refused) a made-over record it cannot keep; an open refuses replacedEarlier with no replaced, and reads only the records the manifest lists.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format (version 5) do not change. A checkpoint written before the manifest listed every taken record of a listed target no longer opens when such a record also has change-record facts. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version, and ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
